11. CI/CD with GitHub Actions (least-privilege permissions, pinned major versions of actions):
  a. .github/workflows/ci.yml: on pull_request and push: npm ci (with cache), typecheck, lint, test, build; concurrency with cancel-in-progress; a stable job name used as a required check.
  b. .github/workflows/deploy.yml: on push to main and workflow_dispatch: vercel pull --environment=production, vercel build --prod, vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod, using secrets VERCEL_TOKEN, VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID.
